serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: UKG provides a Workforce Operating Platform which helps organizations in every industry turn data into decisions that elevate productivity, culture, and the customer experience. UKG includes SMB, mid-market, and enterprise applications for human capital management, payroll, and workforce management. UKG Pro Workforce Management is a cloud-based offering for U.S. federal, state, and local government centers, as well as U.S. government contractors, and Federally Funded Research Development Centers (FFRDCs). UKG Pro Workforce Management is a complete WFM enterprise offerings, including the following cloud solutions: Timekeeping (hourly and salaried), Absence Management (Accruals, Leave, and Absence), Scheduling, Advanced Scheduling, and Forecasting, Long-term Workforce Planning, Activity Management, Data Collection & UDM, Labor Compliance, Global Payroll, Payroll Integration, Employee Self-Service, Workforce Analytics & Reporting, and Employee Engagement & Mobile tools. Also available are UKG Services, providing education, tools, training, and expertise to maximize their use of UKG Pro Workforce Management.
